---
title: Archive & Manage Archive Members
description: >-
  Move member to system archive and review archived member details under the
  specialized Archive List view.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1378" height="761" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Members > Members List, click to view member details.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="245" height="291" />

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="753" height="272" />

2. Click the Archive button at the member details page to move them to your archive list.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="384" height="173" style="width: 384px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Navigate to Members > Archive List, select a specific member from the list to view archive member details.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="254" height="302" style="width: 254px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="662" height="262" style="width: 662px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
